skills.name: chips
skills.description: Run the project's suggested-task ledger: /chips, /chips all, /chips sync, offer, start, drop, merge duplicates, or settle stale tasks. Use for suggested tasks, open chips, and whenever pstack would file a follow-up or out-of-band PR.
capabilities: Node.js 22+ and Git; the ledger helpers and chips.md rule that sync-pstack installs in .agents/pstack; a suggest tool for cards, with the fallback chips.md gives without one

skills.name: cleanup
skills.description: Audit disk usage and remove idle git worktrees, Next.js caches, test Postgres DBs, and unused Bun/npx/uv/Docker caches while preserving active checkouts. Use for /cleanup, /cleanup disk, or freeing worktree/build disk space.
capabilities: Node.js 22+, Git and lsof; a session tool that lists sessions with their folders, or a one-day wait before a worktree counts as unused

skills.name: clip
skills.description: Record, check and render demo clips or stacked before-and-after images/clips for chat, team posts, social posts, or bug repros. Use before recording any app clip or attaching before/after screenshots.
capabilities: Bun, ffmpeg and ffprobe; Chromium for playwright-core, which the skill installs on first use

skills.name: mac-watchdog
skills.description: Keep a Mac from freezing under agent workloads. A user launchd job records memory every 10 seconds, per process and per Claude Code session, and stops any process that grows past 40% of RAM, and a root job restarts fseventsd when its memory leak passes 1 GB. Use to install, check or remove them, after a Mac freezes, swaps hard or logs the user out, when fseventsd holds GBs of memory, or to find which session or process used the memory.
capabilities: macOS with launchd, Node.js and the Xcode command line tools for cc; the Claude desktop app to name sessions; sudo once for the fseventsd watchdog

skills.name: passwords
skills.description: Set up unattended 1Password access on a Mac or sign in to websites and apps without repeated human approvals. Use for new-device setup, passwords, authenticator codes, email or SMS verification, passkey alternatives, and blocked logins.
capabilities: macOS login Keychain, 1Password CLI and an account with service-account access; authorized browser or native-app controls that can consume credentials without exposing them

skills.name: plan-page
skills.description: Write, check, repair and publish plan pages and topic files rendered by .agents/pstack/plan-page.mjs (local HTML + PR bodies/comments). Use before editing plans/topics, at page-work hand-backs, or when a plan page fails to render.
capabilities: Node.js 22+ and Git; the renderer that sync-pstack installs in .agents/pstack; the Artifact tool to publish

skills.name: pstack-doctor
skills.description: Check every running agent session for a stuck or endless loop, find the pstack rule, override or project playbook that drives it, and propose a steer message and a rule fix. Use for /pstack-doctor, "is any session stuck or endless?", "are my sessions making progress?", a session that has run more than a day, a stop the doctor's Stop hook blocked, and the owner's regular sanity check.
capabilities: Node.js 22+, Git and ripgrep; pstack-pulse for live session state, Antigravity ACP transcripts for Gemini 4 Neon sessions, and a session tool that lists sessions for the rest

skills.name: pstack-pulse
skills.description: Show every Claude Code and Codex session on the iPhone lock screen through ActivitySmith and in the Mac menubar, with each plan page's pipeline, and buzz when a session needs you, ships or fails.
capabilities: macOS with launchd and the Keychain, Node.js 22+ and sqlite3; an ActivitySmith account and key; Tailscale Funnel for the session list

skills.name: rca
skills.description: Turn Remote Control on for every non-archived Claude Code session in the Claude desktop app.
capabilities: A Code session in the Claude desktop app, which alone has its session tools

skills.name: redo
skills.description: Redo a prior pstack run at a higher effort or stronger model, treating its plan as a draft and rerunning only units below target. Use for \"redo <plan, page or PR>\" or a Babysit levels failure.

skills.name: sync-pstack
skills.description: Set up the pstack plugin in a project through an interview, and keep every pstack project on one pinned tag and one shared AGENTS.md overrides block. Use to set up or install pstack in a repo, sync, bump or update pstack everywhere, list which projects use pstack or have drifted, compare setups, audit a project's skills for drift from pstack (which to cut, fold or keep), change which work runs a panel, architect or an arena without asking (\"from now on X runs architect\"), or move a workflow lesson, including a plan page shape change, into every project. Not for choosing pstack's per-role models, which setup-pstack owns.
capabilities: Node.js 22+ and Git; the Claude Code and Codex CLIs for plugin pins and smoke tests

skills.name: test-audit
skills.description: Prune low-value, internal, flaky, slow or duplicated tests and bloated CI checks in coherent batches while keeping E2E, public boundary and invariant coverage intact. Not for writing new tests.

skills.name: video-transcripts
skills.description: Transcribe a supplied local or linked video from one frame per second with Gemini 4 Neon through agy, or with a Claude subagent when agy fails, and check the transcript against the frames, when a recording's contents are needed as evidence, such as a bug recording on an issue, PR or comment, or a question about what a video shows.
capabilities: ffmpeg, curl, jq and a signed-in agy (Antigravity CLI)

skills.name: walkthrough
skills.description: Present final screenshots or rendered artifacts as an annotated walkthrough when visual evidence is requested.
capabilities: Real final-state captures, Node.js and the configured annotation tool
